resolution: Mirrored/added faces shared a single atlas slot (they kept the default full-square UV), so painting one prong showed on its mirror and the other stayed white — congruent SHAPE was wrongly collapsing to shared PAINT pixels. The paint pack only ran on first paint-entry or part-count change, never when a new FACE was extruded/mirrored. Now the atlas re-slots whenever a face-topology signature changes (per-part face counts); textureizeScene is idempotent (faces/meshes with unchanged UVs keep their refs, so re-slotting one new face doesn't churn every part), and a re-slot PRESERVES existing paint because cells are face-relative. Tests textureize 11/11; cart bundles clean.
